prose.text: The gates below run in /implement P2 and the wrap's light gate. - The first entry is the chunk's witness. It builds `-p blitz-tests` alone, without the workspace's feature unification,   so it proves the bundled woff2 decodes in the stand's own build and not only when `blitz` happens to turn `woff` on. - The census probes keep network, env and telemetry calls out of the stand, keep sleeps and recorded dispatch out of the   checks, keep `Cargo.lock` free of new packages, and keep the windowed `main.rs` untouched. Their base is `d57a6c69`,   the commit this chunk starts from, so they survive the operator's pre-CI commit. - The boot smoke runs the windowed stand. `app.rs`, `lib.rs` and `timer.rs` change what `seven_guis_native` launches,   so the stand must still boot and still log its identity. The entry declares the display handle `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` and   reads `not run — env unset` in a session without one, never red. It boots for 10 s under `RUST_LOG=info` and turns   `timeout`'s 124 (the stand stayed up) into the entry's own exit 0. The gate tool reads an entry exit 124 as its own   bound (verification-harness.md Session Additions). The `agent-run.sh` smoke form belongs to "Stand test contract"   (health check 13). - Two legs run on CI only, because this host has neither the wasm32 target nor the 1.91 toolchain (measured in   2026-10-06-telemetry-bootstrap's plan: `rustup target list --installed` → x86_64 only). The `wasm` leg proves the   seven_guis cdylib still builds after `lib.rs`/`app.rs`/`timer.rs` change, and `msrv` proves the 1.91 floor. The   operator entries push this chunk and read the CI run that covers both.
